lines.text: Ben reaches the summit, grabs his water bottle, and the lid won't turn.
Water freezes at the top first, right where the lid screws on.
Here's the fix. Fill up with warm water, not hot.
Pack the bottle upside down, so the ice forms at the bottom instead.
Keep it inside your pack, close to your back, not in the side pocket.
Ben twists the lid open and drinks at the top.
Save this before your next cold hike.
